dataset.name: Original bilingual toy scenes
dataset.license: MIT; original project-authored demo text (see LICENSE)
dataset.provenance: Project-authored template sentences; no downloaded corpus.
dataset.splitMethod: Deduplicate exact documents, seeded 80/20 document split, then windows within each document; character vocabulary from training only.

dataset.limitations: Highly repetitive templates share vocabulary and structure across splits. Held-out documents test new combinations, not general language understanding. This is not a chatbot.
